<h2>Run or Reuse One Content-Matched Sensitivity Phase</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Evaluates a lazy phase expression and atomically saves successful results.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_sjsdm_sensitivity_checkpoint(
  expr,
  path_checkpoint = NULL,
  signature,
  phase,
  verbose = TRUE
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="expr">expr</code></td>
<td>
<p>Lazy expression evaluated only on a cache miss.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="path_checkpoint">path_checkpoint</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional directory for immutable RDS checkpoints.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="signature">signature</code></td>
<td>
<p>Content signature including upstream scientific inputs.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="phase">phase</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character phase identifier used in filenames and messages.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="verbose">verbose</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical; print timestamped phase and reuse messages.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Errors and interrupted temporary files are never accepted as results.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>The computed or previously saved phase result.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_sjsdm_sensitivity_checkpoint(
  expr = 42L,
  signature = "example_inputs",
  phase = "fit",
  verbose = FALSE
)
</code></pre>
